summary_en: Cypress Holdings decided to acquire up to 187,500 shares (1.46% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 300 million yen via market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 19, 2026 and February 28, 2027.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On November 11, 2026, Cypress Holdings announced the finalization of acquisition period for its share buyback program, following the board resolution of November 4, 2026. The company will acquire up to 187,500 shares of its common stock, representing 1.46 percent of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum total amount of 300 million yen. The acquisition will be executed through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 19, 2026 through February 28, 2027. The specific acquisition period was determined by reference to the settlement date following the company's equity offering, the pricing of which was finalized on November 11, 2026.
